items.name: Mandarin orange / clementine (whole, unpeeled)
items.preparation: raw, whole with peel on; grams are edible flesh only (whole fruit with peel approx. 105 g)

scale_cues: White square plate assumed to be about 25 cm across; the fruit spans roughly a third of the plate width, giving a diameter of about 6-6.5 cm, consistent with a medium mandarin/clementine.
assumptions: Fruit identified as a mandarin/clementine rather than a small orange, based on its size, slightly flattened shape and loose, pebbled skin.
Peel is not eaten; edible portion taken as about 75% of whole fruit weight.
Reddish smears on the plate are residue from earlier food and are not counted as an item.
Calories estimated at about 53 kcal per 100 g of edible flesh and protein at about 0.8 g per 100 g.
